concept.material: patinated dark tombac brass and rosewood veneer
concept.internal_detail: slender brass escapement arms and minute coiled tension springs
concept.button: a square recessed mother-of-pearl stud nestled into the aft keel
concept.shell_mechanic: The scaphoid hull halves unlock along the ventral keel and pivot upward on lateral shoulder hinges to become folded plumage plates
concept.emerging_parts: A sharp folding beak assembly on an articulated neck bar and two folding brass stilt legs
concept.signature_move: its faceted amber glass eyes light up with a pale yellow beam and its scissor-hinged bill plates snap shut once with a sharp metallic snap
concept.turkish: Gece balıkçılı (kısa boyunlu, sivri gagalı su kuşu) — kıvrımlı sandal külçesi, patinalı koyu tombak pirinç ve pelesenk ağacı kaplama
